edbDesc: An apparent displacement or difference in the apparent position of an object viewed along two different lines of sight, and is measured by the angle or semi-angle of inclination between those two lines. Nearby objects have a larger parallax than more distant objects when observed from different positions, so parallax can be used to determine distances.
title: Parallax
pickWhy: Deck's Distance of stars card is Bessel's stellar parallax (parallax also appears in Distance to moon estimate).
